title: 第23章 不如奖励奖励我第24章 履行夫妻义务
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
第23章不如，奖励奖励我？“你要干什么？”纪寒不由心头一怵。
眼前的唐凝，令他感到陌生。
他扭头冲纪瑾修道，“大哥，你看到了，她这么歹毒，难道还要帮着她吗？”
纪瑾修沉眸，“有仇报仇，有什么不对？”
“大哥！”纪寒心惊。
万万没想到，大哥纵容唐凝至此。
不等他多想，纪馨宁求救的哭声又再响起。
“二哥，我难受，好疼，我身上好疼……”
“快救我，二哥……”
纪馨宁身上火辣辣地疼，疼得直打滚，裸露在外的皮肤红得厉害。
纪寒目露心疼，却又挣脱不开，只能眼睁睁看着纪馨宁疼得不断在哭。
哭声令他失了理智，冲唐凝辱骂，“唐凝你个贱人，我不管你用的什么办法，让大哥这么护着你。”
“我告诉你，立刻去找医生给宁宁看，否则我不放过你，你也休想再跟我结婚！”
纪寒厉声威胁，眼神充满愤恨厌恶。
唐凝的心像被揉碎了，却一点不觉得疼。
认清渣男的嘴脸，她该庆幸。
于是让手下把纪寒拽了出来，绕到他背后，用力踹了他后膝窝一脚。
他扑通跪下。
骨头重重跪在地板上，仿佛要断了似的。
纪寒发出惨叫，疼得面容涨红，“唐凝，你疯了是不是？你竟敢这么对我！”

唐凝绕到他面前，居高临下冷睨他，“在你不去领证那日，我们已经分手。”
“之后，我会跟你父母宣布分手并退婚的事，你我之间，再无瓜葛！”
唐凝声音有力，掷地有声，丝毫不拖泥带水。
面容上的决绝，令纪寒感到一瞬间的错愕，“分手？退婚？”
唐凝漠然，“没错。”
纪寒咬着后槽牙，冷笑，“好，分手，这可是你说的！到时候别哭着回来求我！”
“绝无可能。”
唐凝靠近一步，忽然重重甩了他一耳光，“这巴掌，是我还你的，从今往后，看见我最好给我绕道走。”
这一耳光，打得纪寒目赤欲裂，“唐凝，你别后悔！”
唐凝嗤出一声，懒得再看他，回到纪瑾修面前，平声，“我们走吧。”
“好。”纪瑾修勾唇，眸光宠溺温润。
最终看都不看地上狼狈的二人，带着唐凝离开病房，漆黑的眸子滚动抹惊喜。
小丫头，总算又有几分过去那副千金小姐的样子了。
跟纪寒在一起之前的唐凝，自信明媚，性子善良率真。
有仇必报。
从不是轻易被欺负的主。
两人一走，纪寒连忙去叫医生。
医生看到纪馨宁胸口的烫伤吃了一惊，连忙开始处理。
因为处理晚了，烫伤的位置已经气泡。
处理时，纪馨宁痛得直哭，一只手死死抓着纪寒的手，“二哥，我疼，我好疼……”

虽然是兄妹，纪寒毕竟是个男人，胸口的位置又太私密，他想回避，无奈纪馨宁死活哭着要他留下。
他只好留下来，偏开头没敢看，光是听纪馨宁的哭声都心疼得不行，对唐凝更恨之入骨。
“二哥，我会不会破相了，唐凝为什么要这么对我，上次拿东西砸我，这次又故意用热水泼我，她是不是非要把我毁了才罢休？”
content_en:
Chapter 23 Why don’t you give me a reward? "What are you going to do?" Ji Han couldn't help but feel frightened.
The Tang Ning in front of him felt strange to him.
He turned to Ji Jinxiu and said, "Brother, you have seen that she is so vicious, do you still want to help her?"
Ji Jinxiu lowered his eyes, "What's wrong with taking revenge?"
"Brother!" Ji Han was shocked.
I never expected that the eldest brother would indulge Tang Ning to this point.
Before he could think about it, Ji Xinning's cry for help sounded again.
"Second brother, I feel uncomfortable, it hurts so much, my body hurts..."
"Save me quickly, second brother..."
Ji Xinning's body was in burning pain, and she was rolling in pain, and her exposed skin was extremely red.
Ji Han's eyes showed distress, but he couldn't break away. He could only watch Ji Xinning crying in pain.
The crying made him lose his mind, and he insulted Tang Ning, "Tang Ning, you bitch, I don't care what method you use to let me protect you like this."
"I tell you, go find a doctor immediately to see Ning Ning, otherwise I won't let you go, and you will never marry me again!"
Ji Han threatened sternly, his eyes full of resentment and disgust.
Tang Ning's heart felt like it was being crushed, but she didn't feel any pain at all.
She should be grateful that she recognized the scumbag's face.
So he asked his men to drag Ji Han out, go around behind him, and kick him hard on the back of his knees.
He flopped down to his knees.
Bones kneeled heavily on the floor, as if it was about to break.
Ji Han screamed, his face flushed with pain, "Tang Ning, are you crazy? How dare you do this to me!"
Tang Ning walked up to him and looked at him condescendingly, "We broke up on the day you didn't go to get the certificate."
"After that, I will announce to your parents that we are breaking up and canceling the engagement. There will be no more relations between you and me!"
Tang Ning's voice was powerful and impactful, without any sloppiness.
The determination on his face made Ji Han feel stunned for a moment, "Break up? Break off the engagement?"
Tang Ning said indifferently, "That's right."
Ji Han gritted his molar teeth and sneered, "Okay, break up, this is what you said! Don't come back crying to beg me then!"
"Absolutely impossible."
Tang Ning took a step closer and suddenly slapped him hard, "I'm repaying you with this slap. From now on, if you see me, you'd better take a detour."
This slap made Ji Han's eyes turn red, "Tang Ning, don't regret it!"
Tang Ning sneered and was too lazy to look at him anymore. She returned to Ji Jinxiu and said calmly, "Let's go."
"Okay." Ji Jinxiu curled his lips, his eyes loving and gentle.
In the end, the two men took Tang Ning out of the ward without looking at the mess on the ground, their dark eyes rolling with surprise.
The little girl finally looks a little like the rich lady she used to be.
Before getting together with Ji Han, Tang Ning was confident and bright, with a kind and straightforward temperament.
Vengeance must be avenged.
He is never someone who is easily bullied.
As soon as the two left, Ji Han quickly went to call the doctor.
The doctor was surprised when he saw the burn on Ji Xinning's chest and quickly began to treat it.
Because the treatment was late, bubbles have already appeared in the burned area.
During the treatment, Ji Xinning cried in pain, holding Ji Han's hand tightly with one hand, "Second brother, I hurt, I hurt so much..."
Although they are brother and sister, Ji Han is a man after all, and the position on his chest is too private. He wanted to avoid it, but Ji Xinning cried and asked him to stay.
He had no choice but to stay, not daring to look away. Just hearing Ji Xinning's cries made him feel so distressed, and he hated Tang Ning even more.
"Second brother, am I disfigured? Why did Tang Ning treat me like this? Last time she hit me with something, and this time she deliberately poured hot water on me. Did she have to destroy me to stop?"
